canonical_parameter.value: root ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL;%sudo ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL;%admin ALL=(ALL) ALL

compliance.error: ERROR: visudo -c fails or is unavailable; visudo closure output is ambiguous; a closure member is symlink/nonregular/unreadable; cvtsudoers fails, writes to stderr or returns JSON outside the modelled shape; the closure pathset, its bytes or the cvtsudoers output drifts between the two snapshots of one check.
compliance.fail: VALUE/FAIL: at least one user specification differs from the three stock rules; the value reports the total and non-standard rule counts.
compliance.pass: VALUE/PASS: every user specification of the active policy equals one of the three stock rules (including no user specification at all).

rule.comparison: Each cvtsudoers User_Spec is compared as canonical JSON with the representation of a stock rule; the command ALL carries its implied SETENV option. Any other invoker, group, host, runas, command, tag or option makes the rule non-standard.
rule.not_evaluated: Membership of the sudo and admin groups and Defaults entries are not evaluated.
rule.rule_unit: One rule is one cvtsudoers User_Spec, i.e. one user specification line after alias expansion.

runtime.cvtsudoers: LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/cvtsudoers -c /dev/null -e -s aliases -f json /etc/sudoers; top-level keys only Defaults and User_Specs.
runtime.snapshots: visudo closure pathset with identities and bytes, and the exact cvtsudoers output, are taken twice; any difference is ERROR observation:policy-changed.
runtime.syntax: LC_ALL=C /usr/sbin/visudo -c -f /etc/sudoers must succeed; its closure is the observed sudoers pathset.

source_interpretation.no_authority: No reviewed-policy file is read; /etc/securelinux-policy is not a prerequisite of SRC-0004.
source_interpretation.review: Source requires restricting who may use sudo and which commands may be run by reviewing /etc/sudoers. On a clean Debian-family system only root and the installer-created administrators group hold sudo rights; the product therefore admits only the stock rules (decision of 23.09.2026).

source_requirement: 2.2.2. Ограничить список пользователей, которым разрешено использовать команду sudo и разрешенных к выполнению через sudo команд путём пересмотра файла /etc/sudoers.

vm_evidence.facts: Across all seven /etc/sudoers was regular root:root mode 0440, @includedir /etc/sudoers.d was present and full visudo validation returned RC=0; Ubuntu 26 exposed sudo/visudo through alternatives symlinks.
vm_evidence.matrix: 7/7 integrity-verified Ubuntu22 FULL; Ubuntu24 MINIMIZED/FULL; Ubuntu26 MINIMIZED/FULL; Debian12 SERVER; Debian13 SERVER.
vm_evidence.scope: Evidence validates discovery assumptions only; it does not define approved local sudo policy and does not expand current product target.
